examined_formations.title: MULTI_CLOUD_COMMITMENT_AND_IDLE_RESOURCE_RECOVERY
examined_formations.chinese_title: 多云承诺与闲置资源成本追回
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Alibaba and Tencent already provide commitment-plan management, cost analysis, budgets, anomaly detection and optimization recommendations; dedicated FinOps tooling is mature.

examined_formations.title: SOFTWARE_LICENSE_SHELFWARE_AND_IDLE_LICENSE_RECOVERY
examined_formations.chinese_title: 软件许可证闲置与授权回收
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Current Chinese SAM/ITAM products such as SMARTLIC already discover software, measure real utilization, automatically release idle floating licenses and integrate with ITSM.

examined_formations.title: SUPPLIER_QUALITY_CLAIM_AND_8D_RECOVERY_EDGE
examined_formations.chinese_title: 供应商质量索赔与8D追回微边
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Current QMS platforms already include supplier claim, SCAR/NCR, 8D, quality-cost and ERP/MES/WMS integration. The residual responsibility/root-cause judgment remains quality-expert work.

examined_formations.title: CARGO_DAMAGE_INSURANCE_CLAIM_AUTOMATION
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Current insurance-tech platforms expose cargo-insurance quote/policy/claim APIs, automated pre-review and telemetry-driven loss assessment. Insurers/brokers retain settlement authority.

examined_formations.title: COMPRESSED_AIR_LEAK_TO_SAVINGS_LOOP
examined_formations.chinese_title: 压缩空气泄漏到节省闭环
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Festo, SUTO, Aden, Ingersoll Rand and others already combine leak measurement, software, ROI prioritization, audit and repair/service. Physical detection/repair still requires specialist field work.

examined_formations.title: INDUSTRIAL_DEMAND_CHARGE_PEAK_CONTROL
examined_formations.chinese_title: 工业最大需量电费自动控制
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Existing EMS products already forecast demand peaks, automate load shedding/delay and integrate production/SCADA/energy data.

examined_formations.title: FREIGHT_INVOICE_OVERCHARGE_RECOVERY
examined_formations.chinese_title: 企业运费账单超收追回
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Current freight-audit systems already ingest carrier bills, compare contract rates, detect duplicates/incorrect surcharges, identify service-guarantee refunds and automate disputes/refund tracking.
